skills.name: Deathly Entanglement
skills.description: Nephtys binds the nearest enemy for 5s, dealing DMG equal to 60% of ATK each second. The final hit deals DMG equal to 200% of ATK plus 30% of the target's lost HP, capped at 600% of Nephtys's ATK, and knocks down the target and enemies within 3 meters. Nephtys is Unstoppable during the bind.

upgrades.level2: During the bind, damage dealt each second increases to 70% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: During the bind, additionally deals DMG equal to 6% of the target's max HP each second, capped at 200% of Nephtys's ATK.
upgrades.level4: The final hit's base damage increases to 300% of ATK.

skills.name: Vengeful Spirit Pull
skills.description: Entangles the current target and the enemy unit with the highest ATK, dealing DMG equal to 150% of ATK to them, then pulls them toward each other. If they collide while moving, deals DMG equal to 200% of ATK and stuns them for 2s.

upgrades.level2: Initial damage increases to 200% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: If the two targets collide, the stun duration increases to 3s.
upgrades.level4: Initial damage increases to 250% of ATK.

skills.name: Enduring Soulforce
skills.description: Passive: when Nephtys participates in killing an enemy, she gains 15% of that enemy's ATK and max HP, stacking up to 100% of her own ATK and HP.

upgrades.level2: When Nephtys participates in killing an enemy, she also immediately restores HP equal to 30% of the defeated enemy's max HP.
upgrades.level3: When Nephtys participates in killing an enemy, she gains 20% of that enemy's ATK and HP, stacking up to 200% of her own base ATK and HP.
upgrades.level4: When Nephtys participates in killing an enemy, she also immediately restores HP equal to 50% of the defeated enemy's max HP.

skills.name: Stygian Reprieve
skills.description: Passive: when Nephtys is about to die, she uses a shroud to delay death for 5s. If she participates in a kill during this duration, she revives immediately. This effect can trigger at most once every 25s.

upgrades.level3: This effect can trigger at most once every 20s.

relic.name: Soul Reaping
relic.description: While Nephtys is on the battlefield, she continuously siphons enemy souls. When enemy units take damage, Nephtys records 10% of that damage, capped at 400% of her ATK. When the cap is reached, the stored power bursts outward, dealing DMG equal to 150% of ATK plus the recorded damage to enemies within 3 meters.

upgrades.level2: Enemies whose souls have been siphoned by Nephtys are infected by her corpse aura, reducing Armor and Magic Resistance by 15%.
upgrades.level3: Records 20% of damage taken, capped at 600% of Nephtys's ATK.
upgrades.level4: Enemies whose souls have been siphoned by Nephtys are infected by her corpse aura, reducing Armor and Magic Resistance by 30%.
